page.overview:
Who is Sula Badani?

Sula Badani was an human female of the Jedi Order in an Outer Rim Exploration Team on the Witherbloom during the High Republic Era. She was experienced in traveling the Galactic Frontier, where she dealt with civilizations and cultures new to the Galactic Republic.

Sula Badani was in the cockpit of the Witherbloom when it nearly collided with ship that appeared unexpectedly in front of them. When the ship rammed them and forced them to crash-land on a nearby planet, she commanded Coron Solstus to assist her with using the Force to open a hatch that had buckled shut due to the crash. After escaping from the exploding ship, she and Solstus returned to the wreckage to see if they could scavenge any supplies, but were unsuccessful. Sula and the rest of the team headed to the crash site of the other ship to see if there were any supplies or survivors. Upon arrival, Sula carried the injured Xinith Tarl and joined Ambar, Pako, and EX-5A to explore the body of the ship. She entered through an open airlock and discovered three bodies that had been mauled to death. She felt uneasiness through the Force, but was unable to discern what was causing it. When the group reached a cargo bay, she ordered the rest of the group to stay behind and take care of Tarl as she continued to explore the wreckage. The Jedi was attacked by several members of the Path of the Open Hand. As she questioned them on their mission, she was overcome by an intense feeling of hunger and fell to her knees.

The members of the Path of the Open Hand fled and Sula was able to compose herself and returned to the cargo bay where Ambar, Pako and Xinith were. She explained that the creature that was banging on the hull of the ship was trying to feed on the Living Force of the Jedi. When it started attacking again, Sula tried to remain focused and to assist Xinith in resisting the effects of the beast. She suggested they move to another part of the ship to get some distance from the creature. On the way, Sula discovered a medical kit and gave it to Ambar to use on Xirith. When Pako was able to successfully route power through the outer hull of the wreck and drive off the creature, Sula recovered from its effects.
